description: Known relevant study set for iterative search strategy development, completeness checks, citation chasing, protected retention, and auditability. The filename is retained for pipeline compatibility.
terminology_note: Project documentation should refer to this as the known relevant study set or search completeness set, not as a definitive comprehensive corpus.
selection_policy: Include studies manually judged relevant to the mechanistic or disorder evidence-map scope.
Compile studies from prior reviews, reference lists, citation chasing, manual literature searching, existing curated rows, and automated discovery.
Use the set iteratively to check whether the search strategy retrieves expected relevant studies; missed studies should trigger search-strategy revision or a documented scope/indexing explanation.
Do not present coverage of this set as a comprehensive estimate of all relevant literature; it is a transparent search completeness and quality-assurance aid.
Keep provenance fields so search decisions remain auditable as the set grows.

study_roles.search_development_seed: Known key studies used during initial search strategy development and regression checks.
study_roles.known_relevant_primary_or_mechanistic_st: Manually reviewed relevant study added from prior reviews, reference lists, or manual searching for completeness checks.
study_roles.known_relevant_follow_up_study: Relevant follow-up publication retained for longitudinal or durability coverage, but interpreted separately from primary endpoint papers.
study_roles.known_relevant_mechanistic_structure_stu: Relevant structural-biology paper used to check mechanistic search coverage.
study_roles.known_relevant_mechanistic_pathway_study: Relevant mechanistic pathway or preclinical signaling paper used to check mechanistic search coverage.
